name: Nimnthor Greenspirit
original_name: ニムントール・グリーンスピリット
source:
"...Hmph. This is kind of annoying"
She`s usually quiet, but when she open her mouth, she won`t go easy on anyone.
She`s very slow to warm up to people, but once someone gained her trust, she`ll stick with them till the end.
translation:
"...Hmph. This is kind of annoying"
She`s usually quiet, but when she open her mouth, she won`t go easy on anyone.
She`s very slow to warm up to people, but once someone gained her trust, she`ll stick with them till the end.
